checks.title: Production build completes without errors
checks.steps: Run 'npm run build' and verify build completes successfully with no TypeScript or build errors

checks.title: Linting passes without errors
checks.steps: Run 'npm run lint' and verify no ESLint errors are reported

checks.title: Unit tests pass
checks.steps: Run 'npm run test' and verify all tests pass. Check crypto.test.ts specifically for encryption/decryption validation

checks.title: Prisma schema is valid
checks.steps: Run 'npx prisma validate' and verify the schema.prisma file is valid without errors

checks.title: Database can be generated
checks.steps: Run 'npm run db:generate' and verify Prisma client generates successfully

checks.title: Docker build completes
checks.steps: Run 'docker build -t prunebox .' and verify the image builds successfully

checks.title: Development environment starts
checks.steps: Run 'docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d' and verify all containers (prunebox, postgres) start successfully

checks.title: Health check endpoint responds
checks.steps: Start the server and curl 'http://localhost:3001/api/health'. Verify it returns 200 OK
checks.notes: Health check at localhost:3000/api/health returns 200 OK with {"status":"healthy","database":"connected"}. Note: Container maps to port 3000, not 3001 as specified in check steps.

checks.title: NextAuth configuration is valid
checks.steps: Read src/modules/auth/auth.config.ts and verify all required environment variables are documented and the configuration exports properly

checks.title: OAuth tokens are encrypted
checks.steps: Read src/lib/crypto.ts and verify the encryptToken/decryptToken functions use AES-256-GCM encryption. Run the crypto tests to validate

checks.title: Environment variables are documented
checks.steps: Check for .env.example file and verify all sensitive variables (GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET, ENCRYPTION_KEY, etc.) are documented

checks.title: API routes have proper error handling
checks.steps: Read src/app/api/auth/[...nextauth]/route.ts and src/app/api/scan/route.ts. Verify error responses use consistent error format
checks.notes: Both routes use consistent error handling via src/lib/errors.ts: withErrorHandling wrapper, ApiErrorResponse class with {error:{code,message,status}} format, proper HTTP status codes (401,409,400,500), Prisma error handling (P2002,P2025), and error logging.

checks.title: Database models match spec schema
checks.steps: Compare prisma/schema.prisma models against the spec document's SQL schema. Verify User, Subscription, SubscriptionPreference, GmailSyncState, RollupSettings, UnsubscriptionAttempt, and BulkDeletionJob exist with correct fields

checks.title: Dashboard page renders
checks.steps: Start the dev server and navigate to http://localhost:3001/dashboard. Verify the page loads without 404 or runtime errors

checks.title: UI components compile without errors
checks.steps: Verify all shadcn/ui components in src/components/ui/ are properly exported and TypeScript compiles them without errors

checks.title: Rate limiter is configured
checks.steps: Read src/lib/rate-limiter.ts and verify rate limiting logic exists for API endpoints

checks.title: Regression: Database migrations can be applied
checks.notes: Verified at fix time - prisma/migrations/ directory exists with 20250422000000_init migration. Prisma 7 config is correct (url in prisma.config.js, not schema.prisma). npx prisma migrate deploy runs successfully (db connection error expected without running postgres).
